[IRET.10.6] **An action kind the engine does not execute is refused at
load.** The loader **must** check each `Action.kind` against the kinds the
engine executes, and refuse an artefact carrying any other with
`DS_ERR_DSC_SEMANTIC` ([NERR.8.1]). An unknown kind left to the action loop is
executed as whichever action its value happens to fall through to, which does
something the artefact never asked for.
